name: The Witch's Grasp
source:
Welcome to 'The Witch's Grasp'.

Join our protagonists in this horror visual novel as they venture through deep caverns, navigate their way through traps, and take their last stand against an evil witch who eats children!! Every choice impacts the ending of the game, and with multiple endings, you're sure to have a scary good time every time! 

Can you help our siblings make it through and survive? Or will their last stand be their final fall? You decide your own adventure.

[From [url=https://teharra-rose.itch.io/the-witchs-grasp]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《魔女之握》。

与我们的主角一起在这部恐怖视觉小说中冒险穿越深邃的洞穴，穿过陷阱，并与吃孩子的邪恶女巫进行最后的抵抗！每个选择都会影响游戏的结局，并且有多个结局，你每次都一定会度过一段愉快的时光！

你能帮助我们的兄弟姐妹渡过难关并生存下来吗？或者他们的最后一站会是他们的最后失败吗？你决定你自己的冒险。

[来自[url=https://teharra-rose.itch.io/the-witchs-grasp]Itch.io[/url]]
